title: review-thread-refactor-anchors
content:
TL;DR:
Quick scratchpad for the 'anchor' refactor I started in the serving runtime PR — capture review checklist, split plan, test ideas, and follow-ups. This is messy by design.

Context:
- PR: work-in-progress to extract stable anchor points for request routing/cache key derivation (proto name: anchor-refactor). Goal is smaller change per PR but still land a coherent improvement to KV cache determinism.
- Motivation: current cache key calculation scattered in routing + session manager, causing flaky cache misses after small infra churn. We want a single anchor extractor utility that is deterministic and unit-tested.
- Current branch: local branch 'anchor-refactor/delia' (staging PR 1427).

Goals for this doc:
- Capture review hotspots for quick reviewers.
- Propose atomic PR split so reviews are smaller and reversible.
- List tests & perf checks to run before canary.
- Record follow-ups that should NOT block initial merge.

High level approach:
1) Add anchors.Extractor class with pure function extract_anchor(request_meta) -> str|None.
2) Replace inline derivation sites with calls to anchors.Extractor.extract (start with two call sites).
3) Add fallbacks for legacy keys and a feature flag to toggle new anchor extraction.
4) Add unit tests + golden vectors for known headers/contexts.

Areas to audit (hotspots for reviewers) - quick pointers for reviewer eyes:
- runtime/req_routing/anchor_utils.py: public API and docstring clarity (should mention stable determinism guarantees).
- runtime/session/session_manager.py: where anchor used to shape cache key. Verify we don't change LRU eviction semantics.
- runtime/kv/kv_cache_manager.py lines ~220-260: key normalization. Ensure key length remains within existing limits (we truncate to 256 bytes currently).
- console/telemetry/payloads: ensure we don't accidentally expose PII in telemetry when anchor pulls header X-User-Context.
- tests/test_anchor_extractor.py: edge-cases for empty headers, non-utf8 bytes, long cookie strings.

Risk matrix (quick):
- Critical: silent cache miss regressions => higher token cost. Mitigation: toggle off feature flag, compare cache hit rate on canary.
- High: changed cache key length -> incompat with older nodes -> possible cache duplication. Mitigation: add compatibility mapping and rollover period.
- Medium: telemetry leakage. Mitigation: scrub headers and document allowed header set.

Suggested small PR splits (atomic order):
A) Add anchors/extractor module (pure; no call sites). Unit tests + doc. (low risk)
B) Feature flag plumbing + config default = off. Small test controlling flag. (low risk)
C) Replace call site 1 (session_manager) behind flag. Add integration test in e2e-suite. (medium)
D) Replace call site 2 (router) behind flag. Add load test. (medium)
E) Telemetry scrub + rollout script + canary dashboard. (high)
Notes: keep PR A and B separate so reviewers can focus on pure logic first.

Testing / QA plan:
- Unit: extractor inputs from fixtures (headers combos, cookies, query params). Golden outputs checked into test_vectors/anchor_golden.json.
- Integration: bring up local two-node runtime, send 1k identical requests with header variations, assert cache hit rate > 95% for stable anchors test.
- Perf: k6 microbenchmark for token throughput, compare per-token CPU in old vs new branch (end-to-end with warm cache).
- Telemetry: run collector in debug mode to ensure anchor fields are redacted for PII keys.

Quick grep patterns for reviewers (use these when eyeballing diffs):
- "extract_anchor("
- "anchor_utils"
- "feature_flags.ANCHOR_REFACTOR"
- "X-User-Context"

Open questions (to answer before final rollout):
- Which headers are allowed as anchor inputs? proposal: only X-Client-Id, X-Session-Id, path-prefix (explicit list). Need privacy signoff for anything else.
- Long-term: do we version anchor extractor outputs? plan: include v1 prefix so future changes can be rolled.
- Should anchor be part of the public request API or internal only? Prefer internal. Check docs.

Follow-ups (non-blocking):
- Migrate other call sites (metrics service, rerank) in a separate sprint.
- Add synthetic regression alert that watches per-route cache hit delta > 5% over 1 hour. (linked INF-2392)
- Add a small lint rule preventing direct header-derived keys outside anchors.Extractor.

Patch sketch (very rough) - for reviewer to get context:
- anchors/extractor.py
  def extract_anchor(headers, path, query):
      # priority: explicit header > cookie > path-prefix > fallback None
      if headers.get('X-Client-Id'):
          return 'c:' + sanitize(headers['X-Client-Id'])
      if 'session' in cookies:
          return 's:' + hash_short(cookies['session'])
      # path prefix heuristic: first two segments for API routes
      segments = path.strip('/').split('/')[:2]
      if segments:
          return 'p:' + '-'.join(segments)
      return None

Unresolved items (note to self):
- Add explicit golden for non-ascii header values (emoji in header test).
- Confirm truncation boundary: is it 256 bytes or 512? ask infra team (SRE).
- Double-check context propagation for dedicated instances (private deployments must not use cloud-only header).

Reviewer checklist (pasteable):
- [ ] Read anchors/extractor docstring - does it promise determinism?
- [ ] Unit tests present for invalid inputs + long strings
- [ ] No PII in telemetry lines (search for 'X-User-')
- [ ] Feature flag implemented and defaulted OFF in config
- [ ] Integration smoke test included in PR description
- [ ] Performance notes: sample k6 ledger attached
- [ ] Rollback plan documented in PR description

Conversation snippets to include in PR: (copy into PR description as context)
- "This PR introduces a pure function to centralize anchor extraction. It is behind a feature flag and has no behavior changes unless enabled."
- "We will run the canary in region us-east-1 for 48 hours and compare cache hit ratio and per-token CPU. If hit ratio drops >3% we will toggle the flag off."

Notes-to-self (end):
- After merging A/B, schedule 30-min sync with SRE & Product to align rollout windows.
- Remember to add a short Console dashboard: per-route anchor hit rate and new anchor surfaced distribution.
- Keep this doc updated with benchmark numbers (paste raw figs below after test runs).

-- scratch end --
